Intercīdōna , ae, f. 1. intercīdo,
I.one of the three deities (Intercidona, Pilumnus, and Deverra) who protected the house of a lying-in woman against Silvanus, Varr. ap. Aug. Civ. Dei, 6, 9; cf. Voss. Verg. E. 10, 24.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
